summary: Build omnichannel service operations skills in metrics, workforce planning, quality, and recovery. Explore the practical course and enrol your team.
lede: Omnichannel customer service operations management helps you connect mobile apps, contact centres, branches, social media, and other service channels through one coordinated operating model. You will learn to map cross-channel journeys, define service-level targets, forecast demand, schedule workforce capacity, and identify the causes of repeat contact, inconsistent answers, and avoidable escalations. The course develops practical control through scorecards, quality monitoring, complaint workflows, escalation matrices, dashboards, and action plans. You will apply service metrics, workforce management methods, root-cause analysis, service blueprinting, and AI-assisted interaction categorisation to improve service consistency while working with uneven demand, constrained staffing, legacy platforms, and fragmented customer records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for customer journeys, service channels, contact centre capacity, branch execution, quality assurance, and complaint resolution. It suits experienced practitioners and managers who need a structured operational approach, while remaining accessible to professionals moving from general customer experience into service operations.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to customer service, contact centre, branch operations, digital support, quality assurance, or complaint handling. Familiarity with service metrics such as CSAT, FCR, AHT, and service level will help, but the course introduces the measurement logic before application. No coding or programming is required. You will use supplied datasets, templates, and spreadsheet-based exercises, so basic spreadsheet skills and access to a laptop are recommended.
